# Trade Bid Studio

> Free bid calculator for any trade: turn labor hours, materials, subs, overhead and a target margin into a price, your walk-away number, and what a competitor's lower quote actually leaves you. Plus 121 trade-specific bid calculators.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [Markup vs margin: why 25% markup is only 20% margin](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/trade-bid-studio/markup-vs-margin.html)
